listings.title: Estate - Priced to SELL
listings.description: This is a private estate sale. Everything is priced to sell and MUST go. The house is full of beautiful gently used furnishings and accessories – too many to photograph. Many collectibles including a HUGE assortment of Byer’s Choice figures at amazing prices. Furniture for sale includes a queen size bed frame, free Spinette piano, two sofas (one formal, one contemporary), formal dining room furniture set with table pads, office furniture, and accent pieces. Many kitchen items – great for a second home or college dorm room. Large assortment of decorative items, wall art, mirrors. Vintage solid wood door. Porcelain dolls (some new in box). Golf clubs - 2 sets, several large area rugs and runners, lamps, Longaberger baskets, garden tools, hand tools, workbench, garage shelving. Many items are Fill a Bag for $10 for an average size grocery bag. Smaller or larger bags will be priced accordingly. Byer's Choice and Longaberger excluded from Fill a Bag.

listings.title: Sell My Stuff MARLTON, NJ Estate Sale
listings.description: This beautiful home is clean and well maintained. A local artist previously lived there and there are some original pieces of art as well as some prints. Gorgeous Danish teak furniture in excellent condition. Many books, rare, regular and children's. Take your time to look through the pictures to see the gorgeous objects at this home. The sign-up sheet to enter will be out by 8 AM the Friday of the Sale. We do not give prices before the sale or do pre-sales but please contact us if you're interested in larger pieces of furniture because we are willing to sell them in advance. They must be picked up on Friday or Saturday - the day of the sale but a deposit will hold them for you.

Whether you are an established collector, searching for your next signature piece, or discovering the excitement of fine jewelry at auction, we invite you to explore all 125 lots and find your next treasure. Bid boldly. Collect beautifully. Discover something extraordinary.
